title: POC de Geração de Dados Sintéticos com SDV (Synthetic Data Vault)
summary: A proof-of-concept project that models Brazilian electoral fund-transfer data (TSE 2025/2026) to project future years and explores temporal and multi-table relational synthesis scenarios, comparing several tabular synthesis algorithms. It directly runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, PARSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer, plus its evaluate_quality metrics, to fit and sample synthetic data.
